Help Fritzbox TR-064 1v2: The TR-064 interface has to be activated for a propper function of the adapter. To do this, log in into your FRITZBox and ensure that the expert view is activated. In the menu Home Network »Home Network Overview »Network Settings you have to set the option Allow access for applications. Then restart the FRITZBox once.
Help Fritzbox registration 1v1: In the FRITZBox menu System » FRITZBox Users » Registration to the Home Network the option Registration with user name and password should be enabled.
Help Fritzbox registration 1v2: In the FRITZBox menu System » FRITZBox Users » Registration to the Home Network the option Registration with user name and password should be enabled.
Help Fritzbox user 1v1: You need a FRITZBox user for the correct function of the adapter. The menu to create the user you can find here: System »FRITZBox Users »User. You need the access right FRITZBox settings.
Help Fritzbox user 1v2: You need a FRITZBox user for the correct function of the adapter. The menu to create the user you can find here: System »FRITZBox Users »User. You need the access right FRITZBox settings.

Help adapter fb-devices 1v1: If enabled, the folder fb-devices is created in the object section from ioBroker. For every device in the FRITZBox a device object is created in the fb-devices folder. This option is needed for the speed attribute for a family member.
Help adapter history 1v2: All installed History-adapters are chown here. Select the preferred adapter.
Help adapter interval 1v1: The Interval can be set between 10 and 3600 seconds. This is the interval for the generate FB-devices option.
Help adapter interval 1v2: The Interval can be set between 10 and 3600 seconds. This is the interval for the generate FB-devices option.
Help adapter ip 1v1: The ip address should be insert as numbers (e.g. 192.168.178.1). You could the ip also insert as domain name (e.g. fritz.box), but in seldom cases it doesn't work.
Help adapter mesh 1v1: This option can be enabled, if the FB-Devices option is enabled. For every interface of a device in the Mesh-list a channel is created.
Help adapter password 1v0: The password of the FRITZBox user has to be inserted here. In case of an connection failure it could be helpful if you insert the password again and save the adapter configuration.
Help adapter qr 1v0: Activate to get qr-code of guest wlan
Help adapter qrcolor 1v1: Define qr-code color. Further informations you can find here: <a href='https://wiki.selfhtml.org/wiki/Grafik/Farbe/Farbpaletten' target='_blank'>color examples
Help adapter qrcolor 1v2: Define qr-code color. Further informations you can find here:
Help adapter ssl 1v0: In rare cases it could be a problem to connect to the FRITZBox with https. When this happens deactivate this option.
Help adapter sync 1v0: Enable this option to synchronize the devices list in the fb-devices folder once.
Help adapter username 1v0: The username of the created FRITZBox user has to be inserted here
Help family add 1: With this function you can manually insert a family member
Help family add member 1v0: With this function you can choose a family member from the fritzbox device list. This is the preferred method.
Help family comment 1: Here you can comment the line
Help family interval 1v0: It can be choosed between 10 to 600s.
Help family ip 1: The ip address of the device
Help family mac 1: The mac address of the device
Help family member 1v2: Insert a name of your choice. The name should not contain any special characters.
Help family use ip 1v0: Enable this option to find the family member by ip address. Otherwise mac address is used
Help family use name 1v0: Enable this option to find the family member by name. Otherwise mac or ip address is used.
Help wl add 1v0: With this function you can manually insert a device.
Help wl add device 1v0: With this function you can choose a devices from the fritzbox device list. This is the preferred method.
Help wl device 1v0: Insert a device of your choice. The name should not contain any special characters.
Help wl enable 1v1: If enabled the whitelist and blacklist data points are created. If not enabled you can delete manually the whitelist and blacklist data points.
Help wl mac 1v0: The mac address of the device
